title: Data Handling Module
summary: This module provides core functionalities for loading, indexing, and storing documents and vectors, including in-memory implementations and integration with LangSmith datasets.

nodes.label: Base Document Loader
nodes.title: Base Document Loader
nodes.description: Abstract base class for loading documents, providing methods for synchronous and asynchronous loading, and splitting documents into chunks.

nodes.label: LangSmith Dataset Loader
nodes.title: LangSmith Dataset Loader
nodes.description: Loads examples from LangSmith datasets as Document objects, using example inputs as page content and the full example in metadata.

nodes.label: Document Indexing API
nodes.title: Document Indexing API
nodes.description: Provides asynchronous indexing capabilities for documents into vector stores, managing updates, deletions, and deduplication based on document hashes.

nodes.label: Base Document Index
nodes.title: Base Document Index
nodes.description: Abstract interface for document indexing systems, supporting upsert, delete, and retrieval operations for documents by ID.

nodes.label: In-Memory Document Index
nodes.title: In-Memory Document Index
nodes.description: An in-memory implementation of DocumentIndex, storing documents in a dictionary and providing simple search based on query counts.

nodes.label: Base Vector Store
nodes.title: Base Vector Store
nodes.description: Abstract interface for vector stores, defining methods for adding texts/documents, deleting, and performing similarity searches with various algorithms.

nodes.label: In-Memory Vector Store
nodes.title: In-Memory Vector Store
nodes.description: An in-memory implementation of VectorStore, using a dictionary to store vectors and computing cosine similarity for search operations.

nodes.label: In-Memory Cache
nodes.title: In-Memory Cache
nodes.description: A simple cache that stores key-value pairs in memory, useful for caching LLM responses based on prompt and LLM configuration.

groups.label: Document Loading
groups.title: Document Loading
groups.description: Components responsible for loading raw data into structured Document objects.

groups.label: Indexing and Storage
groups.title: Indexing and Storage
groups.description: Components for managing and storing documents and their vector representations, enabling efficient retrieval.

groups.label: Caching
groups.title: Caching
groups.description: Provides in-memory caching mechanisms for frequently accessed data or LLM responses.
